Jami-Lee | Friendly English Tutor for Kids & Beginners | Introduction Video

Hi, I'm Teacher Jami-Lee! 👋 Watch this short video to meet your future English tutor and see how I make learning English fun, not scary.

In this video, you'll learn:
✔ A little about me and my teaching style
✔ How my lessons work: colourful, interactive and step by step
✔ How I help beginners and young learners speak with confidence

About me:
I'm a native English speaker from South Africa. I'm TEFL-trained and have a degree in Counselling & Psychology. I volunteer with Grade 2 learners in a reading club, and my lessons use picture-led slides, games and speaking practice, plus a hand puppet for younger students.

What to expect in a lesson with me:
A warm, patient, mistake-friendly space
Clear structure with lots of speaking practice
Lessons tailored to your goals and pace

Ready to start? Book a trial lesson with me and let's take your first step together! 😊
